meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入关键词，自动开启代理的专注工作模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常和 AI 助手协作，希望一个关键词就能让它进入更深度的处理
copy.tagline_en: Type a keyword to automatically activate a focused working mode in your agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use an AI agent and want a keyword to switch into a deeper mode

howto.what: 当你说出“ultrawork”或“ulw”时,Claude 会开启超工作模式:第一行回复固定为“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”,然后按强制流程工作——区分任务轻重、注册目标、维护备忘、动手实现,并通过真实运行测试证明完成,而非自述完成。
howto.when: 当你的消息里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”,且该指令尚未在对话中注入时触发。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式,修复这个登录报错。
say.note: Claude 会先建目标、开备忘,再修复并测试。

say.text: 用 ulw 模式重构这段代码,给出测试证据。
say.note: 触发后按严格流程执行,并展示真实运行结果。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork,把这个功能做完并证明可用。
say.note: 每个步骤都会记录,完成后提供证据。

howto.what_en: On "ultrawork"/"ulw", Claude enters ultrawork mode: first line "ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!", then a strict workflow — triage, goal registration, notepad, implement, prove with real-run evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your message contains "ultrawork" or "ulw"; not re-triggered if the directive is already injected in the conversation.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix this login error.
say_en.note: Claude registers a goal and notepad, then fixes and tests.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode to refactor this code and give test proof.
say_en.note: Runs the strict workflow and shows real-run results.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork, finish this feature and prove it works.
say_en.note: Each step is recorded, evidence provided at the end.
